title: SoloSquadWebApi
description: Generated by `solosquad web schema` — do not edit.

AdPlanData.description: `sns.ads` — the ad plan waiting for the owner's 대표 승인.
AdPlanData.title: AdPlanData

AgentBlock.description: One personal entry as an agent may read it. At `busy` only the times are set.
AgentBlock.title: AgentBlock

ApprovalCard.description: W12 + decision 51: what is asked, by whom, of which tier.
ApprovalCard.title: ApprovalCard

AssignmentOut.description: One row of the assignment table (I39): `workspace` null = the whole org.
AssignmentOut.title: AssignmentOut

BudgetSuggestion.description: What Chief suggests next to a warning (C9) — shown, never applied by itself.
BudgetSuggestion.title: BudgetSuggestion

CalendarAgentAccess.description:
How much agents may read of this person's personal entries (decision 60 rev):
`off` (default) nothing · `busy` time blocks only · `full` titles, times and notes.
CalendarAgentAccess.title: CalendarAgentAccess

CalendarAgentView.description: `GET /api/calendar/agent-view` — the read path for an agent tool (v2.2).
CalendarAgentView.title: CalendarAgentView

CalendarEvent.description:
One `GET /api/calendar/events` message — "something changed, refetch". Carries ids
only, and reaches only people who may see the entry (a personal one: its owner).
CalendarEvent.title: CalendarEvent

CalendarItem.description:
A 항목 (`parent_id` null) or a 세부 항목 (one level below). `start`/`end` are a date
(`2026-11-20`, all day) or a local date-time (`2026-11-20T14:00`) — never a timestamp,
so a day stays the day it was written on.
CalendarItem.title: CalendarItem

CalendarLabel.description:
구분 (`category`) or 태그 (`tag`) — per org (`scope_kind` org) for work entries, per
person (`user`) for personal ones.
CalendarLabel.title: CalendarLabel

CalendarTodo.description: A 할 일 under a 항목 or 세부 항목. One with `due` shows on the calendar that day.
CalendarTodo.title: CalendarTodo

Company.description:
The customer company (회사, 2026-11-11) — `core.db` table `company`. The account
holder for decision 45: its 소재지 country (and a 법인's 지배 회사 나라).
Company.title: Company

DemoInfo.description: The demo account signed in, and what the demo server locks (PRD §3.6.4 ③).
DemoInfo.title: DemoInfo

Digest.description:
`GET /api/me/digest` — what happened in the person's scopes between `since` (when they
were last here) and `until` (now). Deterministic aggregation, no model call.
Digest.title: Digest

DigestApproval.description: An approval that arrived in the window and still waits — `ApprovalItem` plus where.
DigestApproval.title: DigestApproval

DigestCalendar.description: A 일정 item that began, or a 할 일 that came due, in the window (not done).
DigestCalendar.title: DigestCalendar

DigestCounts.description: How many of each there were — the lists are capped, these are not.
DigestCounts.title: DigestCounts

DigestDecision.description: An approval someone else answered in the window.
DigestDecision.title: DigestDecision

DigestScheduled.description: A run a schedule started in the window (a failed one is under `failed` instead).
DigestScheduled.title: DigestScheduled

DigestWork.description: A conversation or workflow run that ended in the window (by its newest run).
DigestWork.title: DigestWork

EngineEvent.description: One server-sent event (`data:`); `id:` carries the replay sequence (Last-Event-ID).
EngineEvent.title: EngineEvent

ErrorBody.description:
Every error answer (`web_api/errors.py`). The web shows `code` in the person's language
(`error.<code>`, `params` in its placeholders) — never `error`, which is for logs.
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

OrgPerson.description: A person as this org knows them (`/api/o/{org}/people`): role, title and teams here.
OrgPerson.title: OrgPerson

PayablesData.description: `finance.payables` — the payments waiting for the owner's 대표 승인.
PayablesData.title: PayablesData

ScheduleEntry.description: One scheduled run of the workspace (2026-11-07 — the scheduler joined the workflows).
ScheduleEntry.title: ScheduleEntry

ScopeOrg.description: An org the person may open, with the workspaces of it they may open (I40).
ScopeOrg.title: ScopeOrg

ServerFacts.description:
What this engine server is (the 서버 tab, read-only) — detected, with the builder's
`core/server.yaml` values as overrides (`solosquad.server_facts`).
ServerFacts.title: ServerFacts

SnapshotSettings.description:
`workspace.yaml snapshot` — the keys themselves are never sent, only whether
they are stored.
SnapshotSettings.title: SnapshotSettings

Team.description: Decision 58: a team is its members — no lead agent.
Team.title: Team

WidgetSpec.description: One widget on a declarative screen: `widget` id + its props (I30).
WidgetSpec.title: WidgetSpec

WorkEntry.description: One piece of agent work for Task — a conversation or a workflow run, by its newest run.
WorkEntry.title: WorkEntry
